purpose: Request only the additive specification, deterministic fixture and expected-red test phase needed to define the missing complete optimizer, problem/variant adapters, guardrails, CLI and immutable run-bundle contracts before any S6-E0 production implementation or execution can be considered.

R1.meaning: Create only four versioned specifications, three deterministic fixture files, five additive expected-red test files and one red-phase receipt covering the eight audited S6-E0 gaps.

T.meaning: Run the existing 46 frozen tests separately to confirm they remain green, then collect the five additive files as red only because their five new production modules are absent. No additive test may call an evaluator or optimizer.

P.meaning: Do not modify any byte in the frozen plan, S6-I1-I4 source, fixtures, tests, evidence or immutable snapshots; the new red package is additive and versioned.

N.meaning: If and only if the red collection fails for the expected missing-module reasons and all existing regression tests remain green, prepare but do not auto-accept a separate red-baseline freeze candidate.

G.meaning: Record local provenance commits only; do not configure a remote, push, publish or release.

I.meaning: Do not create optimizer.py, problem_adapter.py, variant_adapter.py, run_bundle.py, cli.py or any equivalent executable production module.

E.meaning: Do not initialize or run an optimizer, benchmark, simulation, pilot, M, C1, F, C2, Stage B or TCAC; do not call any objective or constraint evaluator.

F.meaning: The phase is specification and collection-only: optimizer runs, evaluator calls, formal run packages and formal FFE must all remain zero.

required_red_contract_coverage: A complete optimizer state, initialization, parameter sampling, p-best, mutation, crossover, evaluation boundary, selection, archive/memory update, population schedule, checkpoint and exact fixed-FFE stop contract.
One-call problem evaluator, equality tolerance, finite-value, cache, stable problem identity and exactly-one-FFE ledger contract.
Twelve synthetic problem value/gradient-analysis oracles without exposing gradients to the optimizer, plus a fail-closed CEC2006 identity/conformance boundary.
PARENT, CVGR, DEG_REWIRE, DIV_MATCH, LABEL_PERM, SCALAR_CV and NO_STABILITY adapters with shared-parent-path and domain-separated RNG invariants.
Immutable configuration schema, registered matrix expansion, stable run/resume IDs and rejection of hidden or unregistered overrides.
G1-G5 guardrail branch actions, fixed-budget stopping and preservation of every failed/partial package.
Atomic immutable run-bundle closure containing config/code/environment/input hashes, logs, raw records, graph/donor diagnostics, checkpoints, FFE ledger and failure evidence.
CLI execution boundary that defaults to validation-only and cannot execute without a later hash-bound authorization record and exact phase budget.

expected_red_acceptance.existing_regression: 46/46 frozen contract tests pass unchanged in a separate invocation.
expected_red_acceptance.additive_collection: Exactly five additive test modules fail to collect because alg1_replan.optimizer, problem_adapter, variant_adapter, run_bundle and cli are absent, or an equivalent one-to-one missing-API mapping is documented before freezing.
forbidden_failure_causes: fixture ambiguity or missing frozen input

hard_stop_conditions: Any bound frozen hash differs or the worktree contains an unexplained overlapping change.
Any need arises to edit frozen source/tests/specifications instead of adding a versioned artifact.
Any additive test can pass without the absent production API, fails for an unrelated reason, or invokes an evaluator/optimizer.
Any need arises to install dependencies, access the network, use HPC/cloud/paid resources or configure a Git remote.
Any formal run package, objective/constraint result, optimizer output or formal FFE is created.
Any threshold, seed, problem, comparator, exclusion, budget, stopping or analysis rule is changed without a separately authorized amendment.
Any unit/red evidence is used to claim performance, superiority, convergence, robustness, novelty, physical validity or paper readiness.
explicitly_not_authorized: unit evaluator execution, optimizer smoke or pilot
problem, benchmark or simulation adapter execution
formal run package creation or formal FFE
M, C1, F, optional C2, Stage B or TCAC
dependency installation, network, remote Git, HPC, cloud or paid resources
public release, preregistration-platform action, preprint or submission
performance, superiority, convergence, robustness, objective-novelty, physical-validation or paper-readiness conclusions

completion_boundary.valid_red_means: The missing S6-E0 executable-system behavior is specified and each proposed production boundary has an expected-red contract without modifying the frozen plan or implementation.
completion_boundary.valid_red_does_not_mean: A complete optimizer, evaluator, problem adapter, run system or any experiment exists.
completion_boundary.next_gate: Author review and hash-bound freeze of the additive red baseline, followed by a separate production-implementation authorization candidate.
